title_quote: Hi, I'd like to book a bath.

youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Dog Groomer
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「寵物美容」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是狗狗洗澡：帶狗去美容：預約洗澡剪毛、交代毛打結與皮膚狀況，到店稱重、說不要剪太短，等候時問流程，接狗時檢查成品、付錢並問下次間隔。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'At the Dog Groomer' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Taking the dog to the groomer: booking a bath and a trim, explaining the matted coat and sensitive skin, asking them not to cut too short, then checking the result and paying. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to book a bath.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə bæθ./
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想預約洗澡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what day works for you?
dialogue.zh: 好的，你哪天方便？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would Saturday morning be okay?
dialogue.zh: 星期六早上可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Saturday at eleven works.
dialogue.zh: 可以，星期六十一點沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does a full groom take?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ə fʊl ɡrum teɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 全套美容要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes an hour and a half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt teɪks ən ˈaʊər ənd ə hæf./
dialogue.zh: 要一個半小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine with me.
dialogue.zh: 那我可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we'll write your name down.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們會記下你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a full groom?
dialogue.zh: 全套美容多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The full groom is forty dollars.
dialogue.zh: 全套美容是四十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that price include a nail trim?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt praɪs ɪnˈklud ə neɪl trɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 這個價格含剪指甲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it includes ear cleaning too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ɪt ɪnˈkludz ɪr ˈklinɪŋ tu./
dialogue.zh: 含，也包含清耳朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I'll bring my dog Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我星期六帶狗去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you then, have a good week.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ðɛn hæv ə ɡʊd wik./
dialogue.zh: 到時候見，祝你這週愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's a golden retriever named Momo.
dialogue.zh: 她是一隻叫 Momo 的黃金獵犬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Golden retrievers have such lovely coats.
dialogue.zh: 黃金獵犬的毛真的很漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her fur is really long right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr fɜr ɪz ˈrɪli lɔŋ raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她的毛現在真的很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long fur gets matted pretty fast.
dialogue.zh: 長毛很容易打結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She has some mats behind her ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi hæz sʌm mæts bɪˈhaɪnd hɜr ɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 她耳朵後面有些毛結。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll clip those gently and carefully.
dialogue.zh: 我們會輕輕小心地剪掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you shave the mats off?
dialogue.zh: 可以把毛結剃掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can, but that leaves short patches.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn bʌt ðæt livz ʃɔrt ˈpætʃɪz./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但會留下短短的禿塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what do you suggest instead?
dialogue.zh: 那你建議怎麼做？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll comb them out with oil.
dialogue.zh: 我們會用護毛油把結梳開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds much better for her.
dialogue.zh: 那樣對她好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hurts less than shaving close.
dialogue.zh: 這比剃得很短更不痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she also have a skin problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ʃi ˈɔlsoʊ hæv ə skɪn ˈprɑbləm?/
dialogue.zh: 她也有皮膚問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's been scratching near her tail lately.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz bɪn ˈskrætʃɪŋ nɪr hɜr teɪl ˈleɪtli./
dialogue.zh: 她最近一直在抓尾巴附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That spot looks a little red.
dialogue.zh: 那個地方看起來有點紅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll use medicated shampoo for that.
dialogue.zh: 那裡我們會用藥用洗毛精。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please be careful around that spot.
dialogue.zh: 那個地方請小心一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, we'll take it slow.
dialogue.zh: 當然，我們會慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the medicated shampoo extra?
dialogue.zh: 藥用洗毛精要另外加錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's included in the forty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪts ɪnˈkludɪd ɪn ðə ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 不用，包含在四十美元裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, then let's keep Saturday at eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn lɛts kip ˈsætərˌdeɪ æt ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 好，那就維持星期六十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have you down for Saturday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ju daʊn fər ˈsætərˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們已登記你星期六早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her name is Momo, she's four.
dialogue.zh: 她叫 Momo，四歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Momo, four years old, got it.
dialogue.zh: Momo，四歲，記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's very sweet but quite shy.
dialogue.zh: 她很乖，但滿害羞的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shy dogs often do better alone.
dialogue.zh: 害羞的狗通常獨處時比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have her vaccination record?
dialogue.zh: 你有她的疫苗紀錄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in my bag, one moment.
dialogue.zh: 在我袋子裡，稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, everything looks up to date.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，看起來都還在有效期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we're all set for Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，星期六都安排好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing about her food.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件關於她食物的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should we give her a small treat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ɡɪv hɜr ə smɔl trit?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要給她一點小零食嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She loves chicken, but no dairy.
dialogue.zh: 她愛雞肉，但不能吃乳製品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No dairy, we'll note that down.
dialogue.zh: 不吃乳製品，我們會記下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll see you Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，星期六見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll take good care of Momo.
dialogue.zh: 我們會好好照顧 Momo。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, we're here for the bath.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我們來洗澡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome in, is this Momo?
dialogue.zh: 歡迎，這位是 Momo 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, she's a bit nervous today.
dialogue.zh: 對，她今天有點緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's okay, we'll go slowly.
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我們會慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She kept scratching all night.
dialogue.zh: 她整晚一直抓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the hot spot needs care.
dialogue.zh: 那這個熱點需要處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we avoid shaving her back?
dialogue.zh: 可以不要剃她的背嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we'll comb the mats out.
dialogue.zh: 當然，我們把毛結梳開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the mats behind her ears?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə mæts bɪˈhaɪnd hɜr ɪrz?/
dialogue.zh: 她耳朵後面的毛結呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those we can trim with scissors.
dialogue.zh: 那些我們可以用剪刀修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you wash her in the bathtub?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju wɑʃ hɜr ɪn ðə ˈbæθtʌb?/
dialogue.zh: 你們可以在浴缸裡洗她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we have a deep tub.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們有個深浴缸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And please use the medicated shampoo.
dialogue.zh: 還有請用藥用洗毛精。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll use it on her back.
dialogue.zh: 我們會用在她背上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the shampoo extra on the bill?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ʃæmˈpu ˈɛkstrə ɑn ðə bɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 洗毛精會另外加在帳單上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the price stays at forty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə praɪs steɪz æt ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 不會，價格維持四十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, so forty dollars in total.
dialogue.zh: 好，所以總共四十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with everything included in it.
dialogue.zh: 對，全部都包含在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a very fair price.
dialogue.zh: 這價格很合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try to keep prices friendly.
dialogue.zh: 我們盡量讓價格親切一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time can I pick her up?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm kæn aɪ pɪk hɜr ʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 我幾點可以來接她？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around twelve thirty, if all goes well.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd twɛlv ˈθɜrti ɪf ɔl ɡoʊz wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 如果一切順利，大約十二點半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I call before I come?
dialogue.zh: 我來之前要先打電話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll text you when we're done.
dialogue.zh: 結束時我們會傳訊息給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please text me at this number.
dialogue.zh: 請傳到這個號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, we saved your number.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們存了你的號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you weigh her on the scale?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju weɪ hɜr ɑn ðə skeɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 你在磅秤上幫她量體重了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, let's do it now.
dialogue.zh: 還沒，我們現在量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does Momo weigh?
dialogue.zh: Momo 有多重？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's about sixty pounds today.
dialogue.zh: 她今天大約六十磅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty pounds, that's about right.
dialogue.zh: 六十磅，差不多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a healthy weight for her.
dialogue.zh: 對她來說是健康的體重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she gain any weight this year?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi ɡeɪn ˈɛni weɪt ðɪs jɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 她今年有變重嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a pound or two, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 可能只多了一兩磅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the scale hurt her paws?
dialogue.zh: 磅秤會弄痛她的腳掌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, she stood there quite calmly.
dialogue.zh: 不會，她站得滿冷靜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's usually scared of loud noises.
dialogue.zh: 她通常怕大聲的噪音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our dryers are pretty quiet, luckily.
dialogue.zh: 幸好我們的吹風機滿安靜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will she be in there?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ʃi bi ɪn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 她會在裡面待多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About an hour and a half.
dialogue.zh: 大約一個半小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I stay here and wait?
dialogue.zh: 我可以留在這裡等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we have coffee over there.
dialogue.zh: 可以，那邊有咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's warmer inside than outside.
dialogue.zh: 裡面比外面暖和。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep it warm for wet dogs.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip ɪt wɔrm fər wɛt dɔɡz./
dialogue.zh: 我們為濕狗保持溫暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's shaking a little bit now.
dialogue.zh: 她現在有點發抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's normal, she'll settle down.
dialogue.zh: 那很正常，她會安靜下來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pet her before I go?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pɛt hɜr bɪˈfɔr aɪ ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我走之前可以摸摸她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, a quick goodbye helps.
dialogue.zh: 當然，快速道別有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bye, Momo, I'll be back soon.
dialogue.zh: 再見 Momo，我很快就回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't worry, she's in good hands.
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，她會受到很好的照顧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's eleven, so we should start.
dialogue.zh: 十一點了，我們該開始了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's weigh her by the door.
dialogue.zh: 我們在門邊幫她量體重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She hates the noise of scales.
dialogue.zh: 她討厭磅秤的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one's quiet, don't worry.
dialogue.zh: 這台很安靜，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please don't cut her fur too short.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz doʊnt kʌt hɜr fɜr tu ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 請不要把她的毛剪太短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How short do you want it?
dialogue.zh: 你想剪多短？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a little off the ends.
dialogue.zh: 只修掉一點點尾端。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, we'll only trim the tips.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們只修剪尾端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep her face round, please.
dialogue.zh: 請把她的臉修圓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round face, we can do that.
dialogue.zh: 圓臉，我們可以做到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her tail has a red spot.
dialogue.zh: 她的尾巴有個紅點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll go around it carefully.
dialogue.zh: 我們會小心地避開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her ears are the worst part.
dialogue.zh: 她的耳朵是最麻煩的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll trim them with small scissors.
dialogue.zh: 我們會用小剪刀修剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you also check her nails?
dialogue.zh: 也可以幫她檢查指甲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her nails are a bit long.
dialogue.zh: 她的指甲有點長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you clip them very carefully?
dialogue.zh: 可以非常小心地剪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We always clip them quite carefully.
dialogue.zh: 我們一向剪得很小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she need her teeth brushed?
dialogue.zh: 她需要刷牙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That costs ten dollars extra.
dialogue.zh: 那要另外加十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, just the bath and trim.
dialogue.zh: 不用，只要洗澡和修剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then forty dollars is the total.
dialogue.zh: 那就是總共四十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a nice smell included too?
dialogue.zh: 也包含香味嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll use a gentle lavender spray.
dialogue.zh: 我們會用溫和的薰衣草噴霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please use only a little spray.
dialogue.zh: 請只噴一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A light spray, we understand.
dialogue.zh: 淡淡地噴，我們了解。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's really tense on the table.
dialogue.zh: 她在台上真的很緊繃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we'll work in small steps.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就一步步慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you dry her by hand?
dialogue.zh: 可以手工幫她吹乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will use the hand dryer.
dialogue.zh: 我們會用手持吹風機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That would be easier for her.
dialogue.zh: 這樣對她會比較輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will take it slowly then.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have her shampoo here?
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡有她的洗毛精嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We use the medicated one.
dialogue.zh: 我們用藥用那一款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strong scents make her itch.
dialogue.zh: 太濃的味道會讓她癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we will keep it light.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就噴得很淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is her first real grooming.
dialogue.zh: 這是她第一次正式美容。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First time, so we'll be gentle.
dialogue.zh: 第一次，我們會很溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe take a photo when done.
dialogue.zh: 結束時也許拍張照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We always take a photo after.
dialogue.zh: 我們之後都會拍一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's shy when people point cameras.
dialogue.zh: 有人拿相機對著她時她很害羞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll take it from far away.
dialogue.zh: 我們會從遠處拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it be too hot in there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ɪt bi tu hɑt ɪn ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 裡面會不會太熱？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The water is warm, not hot.
dialogue.zh: 水是溫的，不燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you keep nervous dogs calm?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju kip ˈnɜrvəs dɔɡz kɑm?/
dialogue.zh: 你們怎麼讓緊張的狗冷靜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We talk softly and move slowly.
dialogue.zh: 我們輕聲說話，慢慢動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's exactly what she needs.
dialogue.zh: 那正是她需要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll start with her back legs.
dialogue.zh: 我們會從她的後腿開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, please call if anything happens.
dialogue.zh: 好，如果有任何狀況請打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll call you right away, promise.
dialogue.zh: 我們會馬上打給你，保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's get her on the scale again.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ɡɛt hɜr ɑn ðə skeɪl əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我們再讓她站上磅秤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty pounds, same as this morning.
dialogue.zh: 六十磅，跟早上一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, and please not too short.
dialogue.zh: 好，還有請不要剪太短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll only trim a little today.
dialogue.zh: 今天我們只修一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And keep her face nice and round.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd kip hɜr feɪs naɪs ænd raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 臉幫她修得圓圓的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round face, we remember that.
dialogue.zh: 圓臉，我們記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's getting nervous on the table.
dialogue.zh: 她在台上開始緊張了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's switch off the loud dryer.
dialogue.zh: 我們把大聲的吹風機關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she nip at the dryer?
dialogue.zh: 她對吹風機咬了咬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is fine, but she nipped.
dialogue.zh: 她沒事，但咬了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, did she hurt anyone?
dialogue.zh: 喔不，她有傷到人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but she's really scared now.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，但她現在真的很害怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we stop the grooming today?
dialogue.zh: 我們今天要停止美容嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's pause and try again later.
dialogue.zh: 我們先暫停，晚點再試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't want her to bite.
dialogue.zh: 我不想讓她咬人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neither do we, so we'll wait.
dialogue.zh: 我們也不想，所以我們等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I can hold her paw.
dialogue.zh: 也許我可以握著她的腳掌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That might calm her down a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt maɪt kɑm hɜr daʊn ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 那可能讓她冷靜很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me stand next to the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi stænd nɛkst tə ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 讓我站在台子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, just keep your voice quiet.
dialogue.zh: 很好，只要保持聲音輕柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's calmer when I'm here.
dialogue.zh: 我在的時候她比較冷靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can see her breathing slow down.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn si hɜr ˈbriðɪŋ sloʊ daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以看到她呼吸慢下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you trim while I hold her?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju trɪm waɪl aɪ hoʊld hɜr?/
dialogue.zh: 我抱著的時候你可以修剪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but let's start with scissors.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但我們先用剪刀開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, whatever keeps her calm.
dialogue.zh: 好，只要能讓她冷靜就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll leave the clippers for now.
dialogue.zh: 我們暫時不用電剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she look shorter than before?
dialogue.zh: 她看起來比以前短嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet fur always looks a bit shorter.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt fɜr ˈɔlweɪz lʊks ə bɪt ˈʃɔrtər./
dialogue.zh: 濕的毛看起來都會短一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it look different when dry?
dialogue.zh: 乾了以後看起來會不一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it fluffs up when dry.
dialogue.zh: 會，乾了以後會蓬起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel much better.
dialogue.zh: 這讓我放心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So let's finish the sides today.
dialogue.zh: 那我們今天把兩側修完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you still comb out her ears?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju stɪl koʊm aʊt hɜr ɪrz?/
dialogue.zh: 她的耳朵還梳得開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We combed most of them out.
dialogue.zh: 我們把大部分的結梳開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She didn't like that at all.
dialogue.zh: 她一點都不喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small mats are always a bit painful.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl mæts ɑr ˈɔlweɪz ə bɪt ˈpeɪnfəl./
dialogue.zh: 小毛結總是會有點痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the hot spot any better?
dialogue.zh: 那個熱點有好一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's red, but the shampoo helped.
dialogue.zh: 還是紅的，但洗毛精有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we see the vet about it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi si ðə vɛt əˈbaʊt ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該為這個去看獸醫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If it stays red tomorrow, yes.
dialogue.zh: 如果明天還是紅的，要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, I'll watch it closely.
dialogue.zh: 記下了，我會密切注意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, and keep it dry tonight.
dialogue.zh: 好，今晚讓它保持乾燥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we finish her feet now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在可以修她的腳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her feet are still a bit wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr fit ɑr stɪl ə bɪt wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 她的腳還有點濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only a tiny bit of hair, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə ˈtaɪni bɪt əv hɛr raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 只修一點點毛，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, just around the paw pads.
dialogue.zh: 對，只修腳掌周圍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the price change at all?
dialogue.zh: 價格會變嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it stays forty dollars today.
dialogue.zh: 不會，今天維持四十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for working so slowly with her.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fər ˈwɜrkɪŋ soʊ ˈsloʊli wɪð hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你們這麼慢地陪她做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She did better once you stayed.
dialogue.zh: 你一留下來她就表現得好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About how long will this take?
dialogue.zh: 這大概要花多久時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit more than an hour.
dialogue.zh: 一個多小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens during the full groom?
dialogue.zh: 全套美容的流程是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bath, then drying, then trimming.
dialogue.zh: 先洗澡，再吹乾，然後修剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are her nails part of that price?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr hər neɪlz pɑrt əv ðæt praɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 她的指甲含在這個價格裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nails and ears come included.
dialogue.zh: 有，指甲和耳朵都包含在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which shampoo do you use on her?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ʃæmˈpu du ju juz ɑn hər?/
dialogue.zh: 你們用哪一種洗毛精幫她洗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We use the medicated one today.
dialogue.zh: 我們今天用藥用那一款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wait here the whole time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ weɪt hɪr ðə hoʊl taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要在這裡等全程嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most owners leave and come back.
dialogue.zh: 大部分主人都先離開再回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a coffee shop nearby, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈkɔfi ʃɑp ˈnɪrˈbaɪ raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 附近有咖啡店，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two doors down, on the corner.
dialogue.zh: 往下走兩間，就在轉角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I watch through that window there?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ wɑtʃ θru ðæt ˈwɪndoʊ ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以從那扇窗戶看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the window looks into the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðə ˈwɪndoʊ lʊks ˈɪntu ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 可以，那扇窗戶看得到美容室裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the big poodle over there?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ðə bɪɡ ˈpudəl ˈoʊvər ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 那邊那隻大貴賓是誰家的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is Rufus, he comes every month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈrufəs hi kʌmz ˈɛvri mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 那是魯弗斯，他每個月都來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he friendly with other dogs?
dialogue.zh: 他對其他狗友善嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very friendly, he mostly ignores everyone.
dialogue.zh: 很友善，他大多不理別的狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The little white dog looks nervous.
dialogue.zh: 那隻小白狗看起來很緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is Biscuit, he hates the dryer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈbɪskɪt hi heɪts ðə ˈdraɪər/
dialogue.zh: 那是比斯吉，他最討厭吹風機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Poor thing, he is shaking a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊr θɪŋ hi ɪz ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 可憐，他在微微發抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His owner always waits right here.
dialogue.zh: 他的主人總是在這裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that cage under a towel?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðæt keɪdʒ ˈʌndər ə ˈtaʊəl?/
dialogue.zh: 那個籠子為什麼蓋著毛巾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the barking dogs stay calm.
dialogue.zh: 這樣愛叫的狗才會冷靜下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Momo barks at big dogs sometimes.
dialogue.zh: Momo 有時候會對大狗叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep her away from them anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip hər əˈweɪ frʌm ðɛm ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們還是會把她跟大狗隔開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That golden in the back is huge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈɡoʊldən ɪn ðə bæk ɪz hjudʒ/
dialogue.zh: 後面那隻黃金獵犬好大一隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is ninety pounds, all fur.
dialogue.zh: 他九十磅，全是毛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Momo is only sixty pounds herself.
dialogue.zh: Momo 自己才六十磅而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She looks smaller next to him.
dialogue.zh: 跟他比起來她看起來小多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many dogs do you groom daily?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni dɔɡz du ju ɡrum ˈdeɪli?/
dialogue.zh: 你們每天美容幾隻狗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe eight or nine on Saturdays.
dialogue.zh: 星期六大概八到九隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday must be your busiest day.
dialogue.zh: 星期六一定是你們最忙的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, we book out early.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我們很早就預約滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something is moving in that dog's coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz ˈmuvɪŋ ɪn ðæt dɔɡz koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 那隻狗的毛裡有東西在動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the black lab, poor guy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə blæk læb pʊr ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那是那隻黑拉布拉多，可憐的傢伙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those look like fleas on his back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz lʊk laɪk fliz ɑn hɪz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 他背上那些看起來像跳蚤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he came in with fleas today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hi keɪm ɪn wɪð fliz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，他今天來的時候就有跳蚤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can fleas jump onto Momo from him?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn fliz dʒʌmp ˈɑntu ˈmoʊmoʊ frʌm hɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 跳蚤會從他身上跳到 Momo 身上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not if we keep them apart.
dialogue.zh: 只要把他們分開就不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please keep her far from that lab.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kip hər fɑr frʌm ðæt læb/
dialogue.zh: 請讓她離那隻拉布拉多遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is already on the other table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ɑn ði ˈʌðər ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 她已經在另一張台子上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you treat the room for fleas?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju trit ðə rum fɔr fliz?/
dialogue.zh: 你們會對美容室做跳蚤處理嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We spray and wash every table.
dialogue.zh: 我們會噴藥並清洗每一張台子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a real relief to hear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ril rɪˈlif tu hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 聽你這麼說我放心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We never mix a flea dog in.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈnɛvər mɪks ə fli dɔɡ ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我們從不讓有跳蚤的狗混進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did his owner know about the fleas?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd hɪz ˈoʊnər noʊ əˈbaʊt ðə fliz?/
dialogue.zh: 他的主人知道有跳蚤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She did not, we just told her.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi dɪd nɑt wi dʒʌst toʊld hər/
dialogue.zh: 她不知道，我們才剛告訴她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope Momo never brings those home.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp ˈmoʊmoʊ ˈnɛvər brɪŋz ðoʊz hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我希望 Momo 永遠不要把跳蚤帶回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check her weekly and you are fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk hər ˈwikli ænd ju ɑr faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 每週檢查她一次就沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come look, she is almost finished now.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm lʊk ʃi ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst ˈfɪnɪʃt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 來看看，她差不多快完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, her coat looks really short.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ hər koʊt lʊks ˈrɪli ʃɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 喔不，她的毛看起來好短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mats made us cut closer.
dialogue.zh: 因為打結，我們只能剪得更貼近皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did not expect her this short.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd nɑt ɪkˈspɛkt hər ðɪs ʃɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 我沒想到她會這麼短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will her fur grow back soon?
dialogue.zh: 她的毛很快就會長回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In six to eight weeks, yes.
dialogue.zh: 六到八週就會，會的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a long time to wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə lɔŋ taɪm tu weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那要等很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It grows faster in warm weather.
dialogue.zh: 天氣暖的時候長得比較快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her tail still has that sore spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /hər teɪl stɪl hæz ðæt sɔr spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 她的尾巴還是有那個破皮的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cleaned it and left the hair.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi klind ɪt ænd lɛft ðə hɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我們清潔過了，那裡的毛留著沒剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for not shaving that area.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔr nɑt ˈʃeɪvɪŋ ðæt ˈɛriə/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你們沒有把那塊剃掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The skin there needs some cover.
dialogue.zh: 那裡的皮膚需要一點覆蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the hot spot look any better?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə hɑt spɑt lʊk ˈɛni ˈbɛtər?/
dialogue.zh: 那個濕疹看起來有好一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is dry now, not red.
dialogue.zh: 現在乾了，不紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I care for it?
dialogue.zh: 我該怎麼照顧它？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just keep it dry, nothing needed.
dialogue.zh: 保持乾燥就好，不需要擦什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do you rinse the medicated shampoo?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn du ju rɪns ðə ˈmɛdɪkeɪtɪd ʃæmˈpu?/
dialogue.zh: 藥用洗毛精什麼時候沖掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We rinse it after ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 我們讓它停留十分鐘後沖掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she bite anyone with the dryer?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi baɪt ˈɛniˌwʌn wɪð ðə ˈdraɪər?/
dialogue.zh: 她因為吹風機咬了人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quick nip, nobody was hurt.
dialogue.zh: 輕咬了一下，沒有人受傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you stopped using the clippers?
dialogue.zh: 所以你們就停用電剪了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we finished with scissors only.
dialogue.zh: 對，我們後來只用剪刀完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scissors take much longer, right?
dialogue.zh: 用剪刀要花久得多，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Longer, but she stayed quite calm.
dialogue.zh: 是久一點，但她一直很平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her whole body is still shaking.
dialogue.zh: 她全身還在發抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is just cold without her coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz dʒʌst koʊld wɪˈðaʊt hər koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 她只是少了毛有點冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you hand me that towel?
dialogue.zh: 可以遞那條毛巾給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, wrap her up in this.
dialogue.zh: 來，用這條把她包起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is much better, she stopped shaking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz mʌtʃ ˈbɛtər ʃi stɑpt ˈʃeɪkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣好多了，她不再抖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warmth helps them settle down fast.
dialogue.zh: 保暖能幫他們很快安定下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now she looks like a different dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ʃi lʊks laɪk ə ˈdɪfərənt dɔɡ/
dialogue.zh: 現在她看起來像換了一隻狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A short coat shows her shape well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʃɔrt koʊt ʃoʊz hər ʃeɪp wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 短毛把她的體型襯得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is her face trimmed like I asked?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hər feɪs trɪmd laɪk aɪ æskt?/
dialogue.zh: 她的臉有照我要求的方式修嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round face, short ears, clean feet.
dialogue.zh: 圓臉、短耳、腳底乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ears look a bit too short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɪrz lʊk ə bɪt tu ʃɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 耳朵看起來有點太短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can leave them longer next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn liv ðɛm ˈlɔŋɡər nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 下次我們可以把它們留長一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please write that on her card.
dialogue.zh: 請把這點寫在她的卡片上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, longer ears and a fuller body.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ˈlɔŋɡər ɪrz ænd ə ˈfʊlər ˈbɑdi/
dialogue.zh: 寫好了，耳朵留長、身體留蓬鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you find anything else on her?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju faɪnd ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls ɑn hər?/
dialogue.zh: 你們在她身上還有發現別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one hot spot on her tail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wʌn hɑt spɑt ɑn hər teɪl/
dialogue.zh: 只有尾巴上一個濕疹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her nails seem shorter than usual.
dialogue.zh: 她的指甲好像比平常短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We trimmed them right to the quick.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi trɪmd ðɛm raɪt tu ðə kwɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我們修到很貼近血線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, that can hurt her.
dialogue.zh: 小心，那樣會弄痛她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She was fine, no bleeding at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wʌz faɪn noʊ ˈblidɪŋ æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 她沒事，完全沒有流血。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guess the short cut is not terrible.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛs ðə ʃɔrt kʌt ɪz nɑt ˈtɛrəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 看來剪得短也不算太糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In two weeks you will love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn tu wiks ju wɪl lʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 再過兩週你就會喜歡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alright, let me see the whole dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈraɪt lɛt mi si ðə hoʊl dɔɡ/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，讓我看看整隻狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is ready at the front counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz ˈrɛdi æt ðə frʌnt ˈkaʊntər/
dialogue.zh: 她已經在前台準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I pay the forty dollars?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ peɪ ðə ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz?/
dialogue.zh: 四十美元要在哪裡付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, card or cash both work.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hɪr kɑrd ɔr kæʃ boʊθ wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，刷卡或現金都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here she comes, all clean and fluffy.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ʃi kʌmz ɔl klin ænd ˈflʌfi/
dialogue.zh: 她來了，又乾淨又蓬鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Momo, you look like a puppy again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊmoʊ ju lʊk laɪk ə ˈpʌpi əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: Momo，你看起來又像小狗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was she good for the whole groom?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ʃi ɡʊd fɔr ðə hoʊl ɡrum?/
dialogue.zh: 整個美容過程她乖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She was brave after the dryer part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wʌz breɪv ˈæftər ðə ˈdraɪər pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 吹風機那段之後她都很勇敢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The medicated bath really helped her skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɛdɪkeɪtɪd bæθ ˈrɪli hɛlpt hər skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 藥浴真的改善了她的皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, her back is much less red.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hər bæk ɪz mʌtʃ lɛs rɛd/
dialogue.zh: 對，她的背不那麼紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hold her while I check?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hoʊld hər waɪl aɪ tʃɛk?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以抱著她讓我檢查一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, look at her ears and paws.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr lʊk æt hər ɪrz ænd pɔz/
dialogue.zh: 當然，看看她的耳朵和腳掌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her ears smell clean and sweet now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hər ɪrz smɛl klin ænd swit naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她的耳朵現在聞起來乾淨又清爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cleaned them with a soft wipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi klind ðɛm wɪð ə sɔft waɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我們用柔軟的濕巾清過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is still fur on her belly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz stɪl fɜr ɑn hər ˈbɛli/
dialogue.zh: 她的肚子上還是有一些毛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We left that thin for the summer.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi lɛft ðæt θɪn fɔr ðə ˈsʌmər/
dialogue.zh: 那裡我們留得薄一點，好過夏天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, the cut looks pretty even.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這次剪得還滿均勻的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scissors give a softer, rounder finish.
dialogue.zh: 剪刀修出來的線條比較柔和圓潤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her tail looks less angry today.
dialogue.zh: 她的尾巴今天看起來沒那麼嚴重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it dry and it will heal.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt draɪ ænd ɪt wɪl hil/
dialogue.zh: 保持乾燥就會癒合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do I owe you total?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ du aɪ oʊ ju ˈtoʊtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我總共要付你多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty dollars even, the usual price.
dialogue.zh: 剛好四十美元，和平常一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the lavender spray okay?
dialogue.zh: 薰衣草噴霧可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, shampoo and spray both.
dialogue.zh: 有，洗毛精和噴霧都含在內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some shops charge extra for the teeth.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ʃɑps tʃɑrdʒ ˈɛkstrə fɔr ðə tiθ/
dialogue.zh: 有些店刷牙會另外收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We would, but you said skip it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wʊd bʌt ju sɛd skɪp ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們會收，但你說不用刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, ten dollars felt too much.
dialogue.zh: 對，十美元我覺得太貴了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, we skipped the brushing.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我們就沒有刷牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take a card here?
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡可以刷卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, tap it right there.
dialogue.zh: 可以，在那裡感應一下就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I add a tip here?
dialogue.zh: 我需要在這裡加小費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you feel like it.
dialogue.zh: 你想給再給就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is five dollars for you both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz faɪv ˈdɑlərz fɔr ju boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 這是給你們兩位的五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is very kind, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 你真好，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When should I book her next visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ʃʊd aɪ bʊk hər nɛkst ˈvɪzɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我該什麼時候預約她下一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six weeks is good for her coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks wiks ɪz ɡʊd fɔr hər koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 六週對她的毛剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six weeks would be early September.
dialogue.zh: 六週後就是九月初。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will put you down for then.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pʊt ju daʊn fɔr ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我就幫你排在那個時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we do another Saturday morning?
dialogue.zh: 可以再排一個星期六早上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday at eleven is still open.
dialogue.zh: 星期六十一點還有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, that time works for me.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那個時間我可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are booked, and I wrote it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr bʊkt ænd aɪ roʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 幫你預約好了，我也記下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What brush should I use at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt brʌʃ ʃʊd aɪ juz æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 我在家該用哪種梳子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A slicker brush works on her coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈslɪkər brʌʃ wɜrks ɑn hər koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 針梳對她的毛很有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How often should I brush her?
dialogue.zh: 我該多久幫她梳一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three times a week, five minutes each.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri taɪmz ə wik faɪv ˈmɪnɪts itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 一週三次，每次五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Behind her ears gets tangled fast.
dialogue.zh: 她耳朵後面很容易打結。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start there, then move down slowly.
dialogue.zh: 從那裡開始，再慢慢往下梳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bathe her between visits?
dialogue.zh: 兩次美容之間我該幫她洗澡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once a month is plenty for her.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns ə mʌnθ ɪz ˈplɛnti fɔr hər/
dialogue.zh: 她一個月洗一次就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last thing, her nails at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst θɪŋ hər neɪlz æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 最後一件事，家裡的指甲怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us handle nails, you just brush.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ˈhændəl neɪlz ju dʒʌst brʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 指甲交給我們，你只要梳毛就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, we will see you in September.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt wi wɪl si ju ɪn sɛpˈtɛmbər/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，九月見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She looks happy, and so do you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi lʊks ˈhæpi ænd soʊ du ju/
dialogue.zh: 她看起來很開心，你也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before we go, one more question.
dialogue.zh: 在我們走之前，還有一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I am still here.
dialogue.zh: 請說，我還在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the short cut grow out evenly?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ʃɔrt kʌt ɡroʊ aʊt ˈivənli?/
dialogue.zh: 剪短的毛會長得均勻嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if you brush it often.
dialogue.zh: 會，只要你常常幫她梳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if her skin gets red again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf hər skɪn ɡɛts rɛd əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 如果她的皮膚又變紅怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call us and we will check it.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ʌs ænd wi wɪl tʃɛk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 打電話給我們，我們會檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your number is on the receipt, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈnʌmbər ɪz ɑn ðə rɪˈsit raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你們的電話在收據上，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top corner, next to the date.
dialogue.zh: 在最上面角落，日期旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The receipt also shows forty dollars total.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈsit ˈɔlsoʊ ʃoʊz ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz ˈtoʊtəl/
dialogue.zh: 收據上顯示總共四十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same price every time, no surprises.
dialogue.zh: 每次都是同樣價格，不會有意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guess I worried for nothing today.
dialogue.zh: 看來我今天白擔心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Owners usually worry, it is normal.
dialogue.zh: 主人通常都會擔心，這很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She really does look pretty now.
dialogue.zh: 她現在真的看起來很漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give her a week for the fluff.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv hər ə wik fɔr ðə flʌf/
dialogue.zh: 給她一週的時間長回蓬鬆感。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you think she enjoyed the bath?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju θɪŋk ʃi ɪnˈdʒɔɪd ðə bæθ?/
dialogue.zh: 你覺得她享受洗澡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She liked the warm water part.
dialogue.zh: 她喜歡溫水那一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I will stay and watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪ wɪl steɪ ænd wɑtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 下次我會留下來看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are welcome to wait inside.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎你在裡面等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring her own towel?
dialogue.zh: 我該帶她自己的毛巾來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not needed, we have plenty here.
dialogue.zh: 不用，我們這裡很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything I should avoid before her visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌθɪŋ aɪ ʃʊd əˈvɔɪd bɪˈfɔr hər ˈvɪzɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 美容前有什麼我該避免的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip breakfast if she gets carsick.
dialogue.zh: 如果她會暈車就別讓她吃早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She sits well in the car.
dialogue.zh: 她坐車很乖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then just bring her on a leash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn dʒʌst brɪŋ hər ɑn ə liʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那就只要用牽繩帶她來就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The leash is in my bag.
dialogue.zh: 牽繩在我袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, you are all set then.
dialogue.zh: 很好，那你就都準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing about the flea dog today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə fli dɔɡ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 關於今天那隻有跳蚤的狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He went home before she came out.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɛnt hoʊm bɪˈfɔr ʃi keɪm aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 在她出來之前他就回家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So Momo never really met him?
dialogue.zh: 所以 Momo 其實沒遇到他？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, they stayed in separate rooms.
dialogue.zh: 完全沒有，他們待在不同房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That puts my mind at ease.
dialogue.zh: 那我就放心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are careful about that here.
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡對這點很小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is her next visit on the calendar?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hər nɛkst ˈvɪzɪt ɑn ðə ˈkæləndər?/
dialogue.zh: 她下次的預約記在行事曆上了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, that Saturday at eleven.
dialogue.zh: 記好了，就是那個星期六十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she need a jacket this week?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ʃi nid ə ˈdʒækɪt ðɪs wik?/
dialogue.zh: 這週她需要穿外套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mornings yes, her coat is thin.
dialogue.zh: 早上要，她的毛很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have one from last winter.
dialogue.zh: 我有一件去年冬天的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That should fit her just fine.
dialogue.zh: 那件應該很合她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feels strange leaving with a new dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /filz streɪndʒ ˈlivɪŋ wɪð ə nu dɔɡ/
dialogue.zh: 帶著一隻新狗離開的感覺很奇妙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same dog, just a fresh haircut.
dialogue.zh: 同一隻狗，只是換了新髮型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you in six weeks, Brody.
dialogue.zh: 六週後見，Brody。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take care, and brush behind those ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk kɛr ænd brʌʃ bɪˈhaɪnd ðoʊz ɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 保重，記得梳耳朵後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will call if anything comes up.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kɔl ɪf ˈɛniˌθɪŋ kʌmz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 有狀況我會打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, have a calm evening together.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，祝你們有個平靜的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will sleep the whole way home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl slip ðə hoʊl weɪ hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 她會一路睡回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grooming days always wear them out.
dialogue.zh: 美容日總是把他們累壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, then we both get some rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn wi boʊθ ɡɛt sʌm rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 很好，那我們都能好好休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy it, she earned a long nap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ɪt ʃi ɜrnd ə lɔŋ næp/
dialogue.zh: 好好享受，她值得睡一長覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for taking such good care.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɔr ˈteɪkɪŋ sʌtʃ ɡʊd kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你們這麼用心照顧她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She was a pleasure, truly.
dialogue.zh: 她真的很討人喜歡。

issues.note: 洗毛精／噴霧加價問句仍近乎同義重複（idx 32「Is the medicated shampoo extra?」vs idx 64「Is the shampoo extra on the bill?」），加上 idx 196、204、358 的價格確認，同型問句密度仍偏高；本次已刪 idx 318 一處，framing 各異、非整句重複，屬風格項。
idx 393「Perfect, have a calm evening together.」與 idx 396「we both get some rest」把週六 11:00 送、12:30 取的早場講成傍晚，時間點略漂移（前一輪已指出、未修改）；語意仍可聽，非事實矛盾。
「Behind her ears gets tangled fast.」缺主語，母語者多說 The fur behind her ears gets tangled fast.
「She's shy when people point cameras.」缺受詞，宜作 when people point cameras at her／take photos。
「She hates the noise of scales.」複數 scales 略生硬，宜作 the sound of the scale。
改後「Is the lavender spray okay?」語意偏模糊（是否含在價格內未明說），靠 idx 319「It is, shampoo and spray both.」補足；可懂，非 error。
idx 249 先給居家照護建議、idx 250 又「Come look, she is almost finished now.」，且 idx 266 的沖洗時點落在美容結束後，局部時序為拼貼式前後跳接；全篇為聲部循環腳本，屬輕微。
磅秤情境出現三次（idx 76、100、150），措辭有區隔但略顯原地打轉。
機器信號指 'shave' 全庫僅 1 次、形近 'shape'：經核為正確用詞（shave the mats off，另 idx 25/56 有 shaving 呼應），判為誤報，不扣分。

review.summary_zh: 獨立複核 200 對：四項修改全部成立且無回歸——全篇最長行已降為 7 詞（idx 264 為 6 詞「How do I care for it?」，與 idx 263「not red」、265「keep it dry」接續自然）、idx 110「Her tail has a red spot.」指代明確並與全篇唯一 hot spot（idx 27/55/258/289/315 皆在尾部）一致、idx 318 與 idx 374 去掉重複問法與共用 4-gram；人物（Momo 母 she/her、黃金獵犬、4 歲、60 磅；Jesse、Brody）、金額（40 美元、刷牙 +10 已拒）、時間（週六 11:00 送、12:30 取、六週後約九月初回診）與吹風機事件後停用電剪改純剪刀慢修皆前後一致。四維無 error 級問題，僅餘口語順暢度、價格問句密度與早晨／傍晚時間點等輕微風格項，均逐條具名合理化，予以通過。IPA 依機器證據給分（hard=0、ipa_vote 0 條 SUSPECT、逐詞對齊通過），視圖無音標列故未逐詞複核。
